files.help:
You need to create a new installation of ESP-IDF using EIM (ESP-IDF Installation Manager).

1. Open EIM.
2. Select _"Manage Installations"_
3. Click the trash can icon under your current installation, then select _"Remove"_.
4. Click _"Install New Version"_ near the bottom of the window, then select _"Custom Installation"_. Go through the wizard until you hit the _"Select Installation Path"_ step.
5. Edit the textbox to show the full absolute path of your `$XDG_DATA_HOME` directory followed by `/espressif`. Using the _"Browse"_ button will cause EIM to automatically select a `.espressif` folder.

Your IDE should automatically detect the new ESP-IDF installation.
